svg.title: ComposeGuard actual command-line output
svg.desc: A terminal-style visual showing output from the real ComposeGuard command-line program running against a local synthetic demo.
svg.text: ComposeGuard
Static Docker Compose risk checks
ACTUAL PROGRAM OUTPUT
local CLI session
ComposeGuard report: composeguard-compose.yaml
Findings: 3 critical, 3 warning, 4 info
[CRITICAL] inline-secret at services.api.environment.DEMO_TOKEN: A secret-like environment variable appears to
contain an inline value; move it to a secret store or an ignored local environment file.
[CRITICAL] privileged-container at services.api.privileged: Privileged containers receive broad host
capabilities; remove privileged mode or document a narrow alternative.
[CRITICAL] sensitive-host-mount at services.api.volumes[0]: This mount exposes a sensitive host path to the
container; avoid mounting host control sockets or broad system directories.
[WARNING] healthcheck-missing at services.api.healthcheck: Add a health check so an orchestrator can
distinguish a running process from a ready service.
[WARNING] mutable-image-tag at services.api.image: Pin the image to a specific version or digest so
deployments are reproducible.
[WARNING] public-port-binding at services.api.ports[0]: This published port is not limited to loopback; bind
it to a trusted interface or place it behind a firewall.
[INFO] resource-limits-missing at services.api.deploy.resources.limits: Consider CPU and memory limits to
reduce noisy-neighbor risk on shared hosts.
[INFO] root-filesystem-writable at services.api.read_only: Consider a read-only container filesystem and
explicit writable volumes where practical.
[INFO] restart-policy-missing at services.api.restart: Choose an explicit restart policy for services that
should recover after a host reboot.
[INFO] user-not-pinned at services.api.user: No container user is declared; verify the image's default user
and prefer an unprivileged account.
REAL LOCAL RUN | SYNTHETIC COMPOSE FIXTURE
